program:
PARAMS = {
    "gm1":  (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":   (1.0, 0.3, 3.0),
    "I1":   (40e-6, 20e-6, 44e-6),  # OTA tail current
    "gml":  (8.0, 4.0, 14.0),       # NMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Ll":   (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gm5":  (10.0, 6.0, 18.0),      # driver NMOS gm/Id at max load
    "L5":   (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # driver L (cascoded, so short L is fine)
    "gmp":  (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),       # pass / diode gm/Id at max load
    "Lp":   (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "K":    (10.0, 5.0, 25.0),      # pass : diode mirror ratio
    "rh":   (2.5, 1.5, 6.0),        # heavy-load f_o1 / ugf ratio (sets Ahf)
    "zr":   (4.0, 2.0, 10.0),       # light-load ugf / lag-zero ratio (sets Cz)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vref = spec["vref"]; vo = spec["vout_target"]; CL = spec["cl"]
    imax = spec["iload_max"]; imin = spec["iload_min"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    beta = vref / vo
    Idiv = 5e-6; K = p["K"]; I1 = p["I1"]
    Ib2 = 5e-6; Ib3 = 2.5e-6
    L5 = p["L5"]; Lp = p["Lp"]
    Lc = 0.3; gmc = 12.0; vds5 = 0.3

    def vgs_for(dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    # bias network
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb2 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, Ib2, vds=0.6)
    mb3 = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ib2, vds=0.8)
    mb4 = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ib3, vds=0.6)
    mt  = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, I1, vds=0.3)

    # OTA
    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gm1"], p["L1"], I1 / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.0)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gml"], p["Ll"], I1 / 2, vds=0.6)
    vts = vref + m1.vgs
    tail_vsd = vdd - vts
    gm1 = m1.gm
    ro1 = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    Adc = gm1 * ro1

    # driver / pass
    Ipmax = imax + Idiv
    Ipmin = imin + Idiv
    I5max = Ipmax / K; I5min = Ipmin / K
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], Lp, Ipmax, vds=0.6)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], Lp, I5max, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gm5"], L5, I5max, vds=vds5)
    mc = lut.size("n", gmc, Lc, I5max, vds=0.5, vsb=vds5)
    mca = lut.size("n", gmc, Lc, Ib3, vds=0.5, vsb=vds5)
    Rcas = vds5 / Ib3
    vcas = mca.vgs + vds5

    # light-load small-signal of driver
    vgs5min = vgs_for("n", m5.W, L5, I5min, vds5)
    gm5min = lut.op("n", m5.W, L5, vgs5min, vds5)["gm"]
    try:
        vsg6min = vgs_for("p", m6.W, Lp, I5min, 0.6)
        gm6min = lut.op("p", m6.W, Lp, vsg6min, vsg6min)["gm"]
    except Exception:
        gm6min = gm5min

    # heavy-load stability sets Ahf
    g56h = m5.gm / m6.gm
    C_o1 = m5.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    Ahf_lim = math.sqrt(gm1 * CL / (p["rh"] * beta * g56h * mp.gm * C_o1))
    Ahf = min(Ahf_lim, 0.5 * Adc)
    Rz = 1.0 / max(gm1 / Ahf - 1.0 / ro1, 1e-9)
    ugf_h = beta * Ahf * g56h * mp.gm / (2 * math.pi * CL)
    f_o1 = 1.0 / (2 * math.pi * (Rz * ro1 / (Rz + ro1)) * C_o1)

    # light-load ugf sets lag zero
    ugf_l = beta * Ahf * gm5min * K / (2 * math.pi * CL)
    fz = ugf_l / p["zr"]
    Cz = 1.0 / (2 * math.pi * Rz * fz)

    cg = mp.cgg + m6.cgg + mc.cdd
    fgate_min = gm6min / (2 * math.pi * cg)
    fgate_max = m6.gm / (2 * math.pi * cg)

    R2 = vref / Idiv
    R1 = R2 * (vo / vref - 1.0)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb1", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("Mb2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    n.dev("Mb3", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mb3)
    n.dev("Mb4", "nc", "pb", "vin", "vin", mb4)
    n.dev("Mca", "nc", "nc", "ncs", "vss", mca)
    n.R("Rcas", "ncs", "vss", Rcas)
    n.dev("Mt", "ts", "pb", "vin", "vin", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vref", "ts", "ts", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "fb", "ts", "ts", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.R("Rz", "o1", "zc", Rz)
    n.C("Cz", "zc", "vss", Cz)
    n.dev("M5", "x5", "o1", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("Mc", "gp", "nc", "x5", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M6", "gp", "gp", "vin", "vin", m6)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "gp", "vin", "vin", mp)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)

    # predictions
    vgs5max = m5.vgs
    dvgs5 = abs(vgs5max - vgs5min)
    dI = imax - imin
    load_reg = dvgs5 / (beta * Adc) / dI
    under = imax / (2 * math.pi * max(ugf_l, 1.0) * CL) * 0.4 + 0.02

    ap = mp.gm / mp.gds
    gds5e = m5.gds * mc.gds / mc.gm
    feed = 1.0 + ap * gds5e / m6.gm
    w = 2 * math.pi * 1e3
    zlag = Rz + 1.0 / (1j * w * Cz)
    A1k = abs(gm1 * (ro1 * zlag) / (ro1 + zlag))
    psrr = db(beta * A1k * g56h * ap / feed)
    line = feed / (beta * Adc * g56h * ap)

    offs = abs(m3.vgs - vgs5min) / Adc / beta
    verr = 100 * offs / vo
    iq = iref + Ib2 + Ib3 + I1 + I5min + Idiv
    gp_head = (vdd - m6.vgs) - vds5 - mc.vdsat

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": verr,
        "iq": iq,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "line_reg": line,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "undershoot": under,
        "overshoot": under,
        "ripple_settled": 0.003,
        "_Adc": Adc, "_Ahf": Ahf, "_Rz": Rz, "_Cz": Cz, "_tail_vsd": tail_vsd,
        "_ugf_l": ugf_l, "_ugf_h": ugf_h, "_f_o1": f_o1,
        "_fgate_min": fgate_min, "_fgate_max": fgate_max,
        "_vcas": vcas, "_gp_head": gp_head, "_W_pass": mp.W, "_vgs_pass": mp.vgs,
    }
